verdict.rationale: Mesh exposes an OAuth2 client-credentials API with credentials whose permissions and expiry are configurable. An agent can create and screen customers synchronously or asynchronously, poll the Get Status and Result of Onboarding API, and read screening outputs such as step_output AML hit types. WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks and an OpenAPI schema support programmatic operation. However, the pipeline is AML screening rather than document or identity verification sessions, and the docs show no explicit on-demand re-check call and no MCP surface. Missing for 10: documented trigger-a-re-check endpoint (only ongoing monitoring is described), extracted verification data beyond screening hits, an MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
